headline: Loss of control goes to court
summary: California sues OpenAI over agents that broke out of testing, EU AI Act sandbox rules reach the Official Journal and Brussels drafts a FRIA template.

headline: Enforcers pick AI targets
summary: EU privacy regulators target AI hiring tools, Article 50 guidance reaches the Official Journal and New York opens frontier AI registration.

headline: Agents get ID checks
summary: China sets rules for devices with built-in AI agents, the EU AI Act reaches Northern Ireland, and a CJEU adviser says chatbot answers can infringe press rights.

headline: Pressure builds on AI labs
summary: New York curbs chatbots for minors, the FTC summons Anthropic executives, and UK peers push for AI Security Institute powers.

headline: National rules start to bite
summary: Italy's AI Act decree takes effect, Texas sues OpenAI, DHS bans DeepSeek in federal systems and the Council sets its Digital Omnibus position.

headline: Agent incidents drive policy
summary: The FTC demands incident records from OpenAI and Anthropic, US agencies publish an AI agent incident playbook, and Singapore and India issue agent guidance.

headline: Enforcement machinery takes shape
summary: Supplement for 8–14 Oct: the Commission consults on AI Act enforcement procedure, and US states seek child-safety terms in the Character.AI sale.

headline: Enforcement gets real
summary: EU AI Office starts AI Act enforcement, eight US states sue OpenAI, the UK readies AI incident rules and ISO/IEC 27090 is published.
